tasks.mathematical_definition: Return a deterministic reduced word in adjacent transpositions. To remove ambiguity among multiple reduced words, repeatedly swap the *leftmost* descent of ``p`` until reaching the identity, then reverse the recorded indices. If the result is ``(i_1, ..., i_l)``, starting at the identity and right multiplying by ``s_{i_1}, ..., s_{i_l}`` reconstructs ``p``. Each ``s_i`` swaps positions ``i`` and ``i + 1`` and indices are one-based.
